owner: A owner-local; C common scorer remains canonical
freeze: Before new mechanism fits or comparative outcome scoring
numerical_population: All declared RB query identities; qualified explicit official-stat values with participation; unknown is never zero
point_rule: Unrounded saved point greater than original line => OVER; less => UNDER; equality => ABSTAIN. Grade actual greater/less than original line; equality PUSH.
model_family_count: Mean/median output views and repeated annual fits do not inflate families
offers_2026_W1_W7: Original A PRIMARY_FULL rush_yd RB board from pre-bound grade sources; full board and named source panels separate. Match exact canonical player/event/team/opponent and compatible cutoff; report incompatible rows explicitly.
offers_2026_W8: Original pre-first-kickoff saved board and exact original rush_yd thresholds; separately label source tier. Never substitute internal projection reference thresholds for offered props.
W8_labels: Use the original 14-final-game frozen outcome version plus November5 source-presence qualification/November6 retained overlay. Explicit metric required; retain original predictions and old grades. This is new retrospective inference, not original issuance.
older_offers: Qualify retained source once; missing actual lines prevent actual-line scoring, not numerical scoring. No paid feed or invented prices.
masks: Each procedure full intended query/offer coverage including fallbacks
Stable D0/D1/S0/S1 common core where contracts match
Named pairwise masks against every retained contender and both constants
2026 each week, W1-7 fixed, W8 separate and W1-8 version
paired_comparisons: Every new arm versus unchanged D0, fixed-N S0, every compatible saved product and both constants; pairwise new arms. All pairs retained, no post-score pruning.
metrics: MAE/MSE/RMSE/bias/tails on broad and offered-player masks
probability: No full-game yard law or Over/Under probability from a point forecast. Per-carry EPA-positive probability is a different diagnostic; no EV or confidence claim.

uncertainty.canonical_summary: Pinned C2000-draw week interval where supported, Wilson diagnostic below five weeks
uncertainty.limits: Exposed development, few weeks, repeated players and multiple comparisons; no prospective confirmation

practical_change: Reuse original A FIT_PROTOCOL_V1: existing 2 percentage-point paired full-board reference, descriptive not a new veto; strongest matched controls and uncertainty remain explicit.
stopping: One fixed five-fit mechanism package, no tuning on these outcome scores, no bias offset/side inversion/favorable-week choice. Close no-gain recipe; inconclusive result names one precise dependency rather than unlimited search.
release: Five distinct scored season-weeks per exact product/policy is duration floor only; source/rights/support/admission/current-query requirements remain. No changed Top Picks/probability qualification from point evidence.
